description: Canonical structuredContent shape returned by the lean_verify MCP tool. Added at verification-feedback-m3. Bumped at textbook-ingest-m3 (12 -> 13) to track the global TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION rise from the SEARCH_PAPERS description edit; the lean_verify result shape itself is unchanged. Bumped at textbook-ingest-m9 / e4 (13 -> 14) to track the global TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION rise from the SEARCH_PAPERS source_kind filter description edit; the lean_verify result shape is again unchanged. Bumped again at textbook-ingest-m9 / e4 rectification (14 -> 15) to track the global TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION rise from the critique-F3 ``filters`` parameter inputSchema description fix; the lean_verify result shape is once more unchanged. NO snippet field: lean_verify is a VERIFIER, not a retriever — the 150-char snippet contract (.claude/docs/snippet-contract.md) and the <retrieved_chunk> indirect-prompt-injection wrapping (E13_S02 Threat 2) apply ONLY to retrieval tools whose results are paper-derived text. The ``version`` field below MUST equal server.tools.TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION (cross-checked by tests/test_handlers_lean_verify.py::TestToolRegistration::test_schema_version_matches_tool_schema_version) — that cross-check, plus the tests/test_handlers_lean_verify.py::TestLeanVerifyResultSchema Draft7Validator conformance suite (m3 critique F2), is the contract guard for this file; there is NO byte-hash pin on the file itself today (the E06_S06 ``EXPECTED_TOOL_SCHEMA_SHA256`` covers the canonical ``tools/list`` response JSON, not this result-row schema).

compilation_success.description: Whether the Lean kernel accepted the snippet. true iff status == 'ok' (no error-severity messages AND no unresolved sorries). false on type errors, unresolved sorries, timeouts. null when mode == 'syntax_only' AND the snippet elaborated cleanly (kernel verification was not run, so 'success' is not defined). Derived field — the leanprover-community/repl protocol does not emit it directly.

corpus_version.description: The integer corpus_version pinned at server startup (per E04_S03's corpus-version.json marker). Echoed in every tool result envelope so the agent can correlate cached results.

goals_remaining.description: Goal strings (one per unresolved ``sorry``) the prover still owes. Derived from sorries[*].goal. Empty list means the snippet's proof is closed (or the snippet is a definition, not a theorem). Each string is a Lean proof state in the form 'hypotheses\n⊢ conclusion'.

lean_status.description: Reports the Lean REPL's availability. 'available' on the happy path. 'disabled' when ARXMCP_ENABLE_LEAN=false (the tool is registered for BP1 cache stability but the REPL is None — the call returns gracefully, not 5xx). 'timeout' when the snippet exceeded the 30s per-query wall-clock; the REPL is killed and respawned before the next call.

messages.description: Diagnostic messages emitted by the Lean elaborator + kernel. Empty list on a clean compile. Each message reports the source position (zero-indexed line + column from the snippet text), the severity ('error' / 'warning' / 'info'), and the message body. Mapped from the leanprover-community/repl response: REPL key 'pos' renamed to 'position', REPL key 'data' renamed to 'text'.

position.description: Zero-indexed source position emitted by the Lean elaborator/kernel. {0, 0} when the REPL response omits a position (e.g. a snippet-level error that has no specific line).

text.description: Lean diagnostic message body (verbatim from the elaborator/kernel).

mode.description: Echo of the requested verification mode. 'full' runs elaboration AND kernel verification ({"cmd": snippet}). 'syntax_only' wraps the snippet for elaboration only ({"cmd": "#check (snippet)"}); kernel decide-instances + reducibility are skipped — cheap pre-verify for the autoformalizer. The Lean REPL protocol has no native syntax_only flag; the #check wrapping is the documented mechanism.

proof_state.description: The first unresolved goal (sorries[0].goal) verbatim, or null when no sorries remain. Convenience accessor for the autoformalizer; the full list is in goals_remaining + sorry_goals.

sorry_goals.description: Full sorry rows from the leanprover-community/repl response. Each row carries the goal string and its source position so the tactician can target a specific sorry by location. Empty list when no sorries remain.

goal.description: The Lean proof state at this sorry, in the form 'hypotheses\n⊢ conclusion'.

status.description: High-level verification outcome. Precedence: 'unavailable' (the REPL is disabled or initial spawn never happened) > 'timeout' (snippet exceeded the per-query wall-clock; REPL was killed + respawned) > 'error' (any message with severity=='error') > 'sorry' (no errors but at least one unresolved sorry) > 'ok' (clean). A successful tool call returns 'error' / 'sorry' / 'ok' WITHOUT MCP isError=true — those are *kernel* outcomes, not RPC failures. Only 'timeout' / 'unavailable' may be paired with an isError content block by future revisions.
